# README banner

`banner.jpg` is the picture at the top of the README. It was generated locally with Z-Image Turbo (bf16) in ComfyUI: 1536x640, 9 steps, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple, seed 3429952732, then resized to 1280x533 and saved as JPEG. The same prompt and seed give the same picture.

Prompt:

> the left half and the right half of one mountain landscape painting being slid together on a gallery wall until their edges touch, forming one wide seamless panorama, a thin seam where they meet, wide cinematic banner illustration, painterly digital art, soft volumetric light, rich but muted colour palette, detailed, storybook atmosphere, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark
